reference_semantics.name: frozen historical LLM judgement
reference_semantics.interpretation: Agreement reconstructs a historical prompt instrument; disagreement does not by itself establish that either channel is correct.

registered_universe.partition: sorted identifiers, random.Random(7).shuffle, complement of first 150, then sorted opaque enumeration
registered_universe.changed_row_policy: Exclude sanitizer-changed rows from every historical raw-reference exact-input primary comparison. Report them only as a separate representation-mismatch sensitivity stratum, without combining strata.

raw_prompt.program: fresh GLM-4.7 reasoning-off prompt-only request over sanitized ctext

unavailability_reasons: no independent whole-scalar adversary is frozen

hybrid.program: fresh GLM-4.7 reasoning-off hybrid request over identical sanitized ctext plus deterministic CodeScope-v3 facts

channel_comparisons.interpretation: Channel comparisons are agreement and difference analyses, never accuracy against truth.
metrics: Spearman rank correlation when pair_count >= 3 and both variables vary
Pearson correlation when pair_count >= 3 and both variables vary
channel_comparisons.undefined_policy: If a metric's sample-size or variance precondition fails, report it as undefined; do not substitute zero.
channel_comparisons.multiplicity_policy: Report all registered comparisons with no selective omission and no target-informed tuning.

historical_reference_reconstruction.interpretation: Each comparison is reconstruction of a frozen prompt-reference replay, not validation against external truth.
historical_reference_reconstruction.primary_subset: 99 exact-input rows expected after excluding the one sanitizer-changed heldout row
historical_reference_reconstruction.code_interpretation_guard: The code scalar comparison is descriptive reconstruction of a structural partial aggregate and cannot establish whole-construct scalar fidelity.
historical_reference_reconstruction.changed_row_sensitivity: Report the changed row separately if a steward-authorized evaluator later accesses the raw reference; never merge it into the 99-row exact-input primary subset.

isomorphism_gate.construct_fidelity: Pass only when the compared arms bind the exact articulated-contract hash and preserve relation orientation and semantics.
isomorphism_gate.evidence_content_and_input_fidelity: Pass only when compared inputs have exact canonical sanitized-ctext equality and every additional evidence surface is declared and hash-bound; raw historical text is not exact-input faithful for sanitizer-changed rows.
isomorphism_gate.program_fidelity: Pass only on an audited program-level correspondence, including aggregation and abstention behavior; shared construct wording alone is insufficient.
isomorphism_gate.reference_instrument_fidelity: Pass only when the historical prompt, model identity, decoding settings, transport, and output interpretation are hash-bound or an explicit audited equivalence is established.
isomorphism_gate.three_state_rule: Each dimension is pass, fail, or unavailable. Full isomorphism is established only if all four pass; fail or unavailable cannot be promoted by agreement statistics.

ablation_plan.method: For covered rows, freeze each exposed subrelation score and a leave-one-family-out renormalization of the candidate's already-frozen structural weights. Do not compute a whole-construct code score for semantic_context_fit.
ablation_plan.no_declaration_policy: All ablation scalars are null because neutral 0.5 is noncoverage.
